The view from the veranda seat is lovely.
Aug 2026 • Family
I reserved a table by the river on the second floor a month ago.
There are seats along the river on the second floor on the day, and we were guided to the seat with the best view of the river lanterns at night, and the atmosphere was wonderful.
The menu had so many options besides Vietnamese food, like Chinese food and pizza, that I was lost, but since I had been to a Vietnamese restaurant the day before, it was difficult to find anything other than what I had eaten there.
In the end, I ordered the same White Rose, etc. The white rose was delicious.
The price is a tourist price, a little higher than a Vietnamese restaurant.
I am satisfied because I was able to enjoy the scenery of Hoi An from evening to night.

気取らず楽しめる、ホイアンらしさと洋食が混ざるディナー（Casual Dinner with Both Vietnamese and Western Options）
Apr 2026 • Couples
ホイアン滞在中のメインディナーとして予約して利用しました。

全体の印象としては、想像していたよりもずっとカジュアルでしたが、その分リラックスして過ごせました。1日観光して汗だくで疲れている状態だったので、気を張らずにいられる雰囲気はむしろありがたく、結果的にちょうど良いバランスでした。

ベトナム料理と洋食のフュージョンと聞いて訪れましたが、実際には「どちらも楽しめるレストラン」という印象です。ベトナム料理は比較的リーズナブルで味も良く、洋食はそれなりの価格ですが、その分しっかりしたものが提供されていると感じました。

事前におすすめと聞いていたダックやポーク、チョコケーキやブリュレは、そのままの名前のメニューは見当たらず、結果的にベトナム料理と洋食を半々くらいで注文しました。その中ではラビオリとシーフードリゾットが特に印象に残っています。

予約をしておくと、川に面した2階の席を用意してもらえるのも良いポイントです。

どの料理も総じて満足度が高く、また訪れたいと思えるお店でした。

⸻
We made a reservation here for our main dinner during our stay in Hoi An.

Overall, the restaurant felt much more casual than we had expected, but that actually made it easier to relax. After a full day of sightseeing in the heat, it was nice not to be in a place that required dressing up or too much formality—it turned out to be a pleasant contrast.

We had heard it was a fusion of Vietnamese and Western cuisine, but in reality, it felt more like a place where you can enjoy both. The Vietnamese dishes were reasonably priced and very good, while the Western dishes were a bit more expensive but tasted worth the price.

We had heard recommendations for duck, pork, chocolate cake, and crème brûlée, but couldn’t find those exact items on the menu. In the end, we ordered a mix of Vietnamese and Western dishes, about half and half. The ravioli and seafood risotto stood out the most for us.

If you make a reservation, you can get a table on the second floor with a nice riverside view, which is a great touch.

Overall, everything we tried was satisfying, and it’s a place we would happily visit again.
